Name: Sense Lifeblood
Description:
As part of casting this spell, you must expend two Hit Dice or the spell automatically fails. If you do, you can sense the lifeblood flowing within creatures you can see.

For the duration, you can sense whether and how two or more creatures you can see are related biologically. In addition, you know whether a creature's current hit points are equal to or below half its hit point maximum. Whenever you deal damage to such a creature, you roll two additional dice to deal bonus damage. The dice rolled to determine this bonus damage are the same as the two Hit Dice you expended to cast this spell.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a 4th- or 5th-level spell slot, you can maintain concentration on this spell for up to 1 hour. When you cast this spell using a 6th-level or higher spell slot, you can maintain concentration on this spell for up to 8 hours.
